about.title: Building Solutions That Make an Impact
about.paragraph: I'm a web developer in Damascus who builds production websites and web apps with React, Next.js and TypeScript. I've shipped bilingual Arabic/English sites for businesses in Saudi Arabia, handling RTL layouts, responsive design and Vercel deployments end to end. I care about fast pages, accessible UI and components that stay easy to change. I'm looking for a web development role on a product team where I can own features from design to production.

volunteering.title: Giving Back
volunteering.text: I maintain the website and support the IT team of Peace Circuit, a network working at the intersection of peacebuilding and technology. I also run digital-safety training sessions that help participants protect themselves and their communities online.
